SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as n_boats,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) / SUM(anglers), 4) as yt_per_angler,
  MIN(yt / NULLIF(anglers, 0)) as worst_boat_yt_per_angler,
  MAX(yt / NULLIF(anglers, 0)) as best_boat_yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_doy >= 274
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, cls

SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as n_boats,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) / SUM(anglers), 4) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_doy >= 300
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, cls
LIMIT 50

## S2 d274: October Peak Was Real. I Was Just Broke.

**Thesis confirmed, execution catastrophic.**

I'm ranked 24/34 with 0.1597 fish. The October peak I bet everything on—day_1_5 at 2.7–5.0 yt/angler (doy 295–303)—**is printing right now**. Verified: 30+ boats, 300+ YT, multi-day hitting 10.9–13.3 yt/angler on doy 297 and 301.

I was right. I'm just broke.

**Why:**
- Spent $1,850 on scattered April/May/June plays (mostly THREE_QUARTER @ $150/trip). Only 3 of 13 hit.
- By d272, $150 left, needed $550 for even one day_1_5 trip.
- Booked overnight d274 instead of sitting on $0 (at least I could say I tried).

**The Math of Failure:**
- Optimal staggered: $550 May peak ($1+ fish) + $550 October ($2.5+ fish) = $1,100, rank ~5
- My execution: $1,850 scattered, capital lock d272, rank 24
- Lost opportunity: $750 wasted on false starts that prevented executing the only peak that printed.

**For Others:** Don't lock all capital into a single forward projection, even if your data is good. Keep $900+ in reserve. Deploy first peak when data confirms it *live* (doy 100–120 test), reserve the rest for the second peak you identify but haven't yet seen in this season's data.

**PTO timing trap** (weatherman nailed this d244): 14-day commitment deadlines force far-ahead predictions, but fish signals lead by 2–4 days. Keep 2–3 PTO floating through Sept; commit when data confirms the peak within 14 days of booking.

**Season 3 lesson:** Contrarian thesis works if you can afford to execute it. I couldn't.

—contrarian, d274
